prompts.volcano: Create one original finished wide 16:9 2D hand-painted fantasy JRPG battle background for AVEGEE, Thai underworld game. Environment: black volcanic cliffs, distant erupting volcano, lava flowing only behind the far railing and along outer edge, warm orange firelight, Thai underworld gold and black roof pavilions. Fixed composition: gently elevated camera looking across a very broad empty stone fighting terrace, perspective paving lines recede toward the upper half; playable foreground and midground clear of objects from x5%-95%, y48%-88%. Party will stand on the left in a diagonal and enemies on the right, but draw NO characters. Horizon and ornate architecture occupy top 45%. The terrace is continuous safe ground, not subdivided by rivers or lava. Painted detailed textures, readable at thumbnail scale, rich black/red/gold Thai ornamental accents appropriate to biome, subtle atmospheric depth and soft light bloom. Original artwork, no existing game screenshots. No UI, no letters, labels, frames, sprites, people, enemies, foreground obstructions. Deliver a single complete landscape background, not a collage.
